name: Ashen Spire painted fantasy world

shared.rendering: Tactile hand-painted fantasy; matte broad forms, restrained fine detail, subtle material edges.
shared.biomeVariation: Change climate, vegetation, wear and accent palette while preserving brushwork/material vocabulary.
shared.timeVariation: Night, firelight and interiors intentionally change values; a tint alone does not relight a daytime painting.
shared.review: Style IDs record a visual review, not proof of visual similarity. Compare each new component within its role and in a layered scene.

productionLimits: Measured alpha cleanup, source overscan and calibrated anchors remain per-asset tasks.
Existing wide paintings do not automatically satisfy every portrait or ultrawide camera motion.
Never upscale a small draft and describe it as a new high-resolution master.
